name: hxwerks
description: Leadwerks 5 Haxe/Lua bindings and entity-script tooling — full API coverage (Entity, World, Camera, GUI, Collider, Joint, Steamworks, PhysX, VR, UI widgets, and more).
releasenote: Entity.scene typed as Scene; fixed TransformPoint/TransformNormal arg order (point,src,dst); ATan with overloads; added Ceil, MixAngle, Hex, Angle, DeltaAngle, Step, StepAngle, Dec, Degrees, Radians, SeedRandom, FileSize/Time/Hidden, AppDir/Path, Command, CurrentDir, ChangeDir, CreateDir/DeleteDir/DeleteFile/RenameFile, CasedPath/RealPath, ExtractDir/Ext/StripDir/Ext/All, GetPath, LoadDir, OpenDir, CreateFile, GetFileExtensions/Pattern, Confirm/Proceed/Message/RequestFile/RequestDir, Assert, Uuid, GetMemoryUsage, GetLuaState, PollDebugger, RuntimeError, WString, FetchUrl, DownloadFile, ASyncDownloadFile, SaveTable/LoadTable, RunFile, GetHmd, GetGamePads, SetHrtf, FlushEvents, ClearPostEffects, LoadIcon/ShaderFamily/Collider, CreateCollisionBox; marked CreateStaticBuffer data as userdata pointer. Entity.hx: FireOutputs removed (not in official docs). Quat.Length reverted (property not in docs).
